notes.overrides: components/ui and components/reui are the design system itself (installed by the shadcn CLI, edited in place): they write the classes everyone else may not restyle, and stock components use arbitrary values, inline styles for measured geometry and runtime-built classes by design (data-grid, charts, sidebar). So no-restyle, no-arbitrary-values, no-inline-styles and require-static-classes are off inside them; no-raw-colors and no-unknown-classes stay on, since stock code uses tokens.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.contracts: A caller places a component (margin, width, flex/grid position) and picks its variant and size props; it never restyles it. Spacing, colour, shape and type are the component's, set where it is defined in components/ui or components/reui. Need something the component does not offer? Add a variant or size to the component file there, in place, so every caller gets it.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.Button: Button owns its height, padding, radius and colour: variant and size props only. size="icon" and size="icon-sm" are the square icon button. A caller may place it (w-full, margins) and nothing else.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.DialogContent: Overlay content owns its geometry (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Popover): width, position and layering belong to the component, so a dialog is not a different width on every screen. A width the component lacks is a size variant added to components/ui/dialog.tsx (or sheet.tsx, popover.tsx), not a className at the call site.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.CardTitle: CardTitle and FrameTitle are sized by the component. Colour and truncation are allowed; text size, font weight and leading are not.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.Badge: Badge is coloured by what it means: variant="success-light" and friends, at the default size. A caller may place it and nothing else.
notes.shadcn/no-raw-colors.allow: The categorical palette. AGENTS.md permits a raw palette class (bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400) only for categorical identity, where the colour tells one thing from another (a tag colour, a file-type tint, a chart series), never for state, and always with its dark: pair. A class is allowed here by hue family; state uses Badge variants or Alert variants, and chrome uses semantic tokens (bg-background, text-muted-foreground). Reviewers check the dark: pair, which the linter cannot see.
notes.shadcn/no-inline-styles.allow: Only dynamic CSS custom properties pass: style={{ '--row-depth': depth }}, read by a class; and animationDelay, the one supported way to stagger a list (staggerDelay(i) from lib/motion.ts, never a literal: the motion rule rejects that). Anywhere geometry has to be computed at runtime (virtualised rows, drag overlays, resizable panes, the editor gutter, the graph canvas) it is a scoped override below, one path per entry, each saying why. Static values never belong in style; make them classes.
notes.shadcn/no-unknown-classes.allow.motion: Holi's own motion vocabulary from src/renderer/src/index.css: motion-respond (hover and press), motion-in-* and motion-out-* (arriving and leaving), motion-ack-* (acknowledging an action), motion-pulse and motion-shimmer (waiting). These are @utility rules the linter cannot classify, and they are the only way a duration or curve reaches a component.
notes.shadcn/no-unknown-classes.allow.third-pa: Markers other libraries or stock components select on: ProseMirror and tiptap (the note editor), cm-* (CodeMirror), xterm* (the agent terminal), rdp-* (react-day-picker), cn-* (shadcn's radix-nova style hooks, defined in shadcn/tailwind.css), toaster (Sonner). They generate no utility CSS on purpose.
notes.shadcn/no-unknown-classes.allow.own-styl: Classes of a component's own stylesheet rather than a Tailwind utility: obrit-* and onboarding-ritual are features/onboarding's ritual (onboarding-ritual.css, a one-time ceremony with its own palette and spring); pixel-persona* is composites/pixel-persona. Each goes when its stylesheet is rewritten as utilities. Add to this list only for a stylesheet that exists, never to silence a misspelling.
notes.shadcn/require-static-classes: A class built at runtime (`bg-${color}`) cannot be read by Tailwind or the linter. Choose between whole static class strings: a lookup table of full class names, or a cva variant.

message.default: {{component}} chooses its own size and colour: variant={{variants}}, and the size prop for how big it is (size="icon" for a square icon button). A caller may only place it (w-full, margins).
message.spacing: {{component}} pads itself through its size prop: size={{sizes}}. A caller may only place it (w-full, margins).

contracts.message: Overlay content owns its geometry: {{component}} is sized, positioned and layered by the component, never by the caller. A width or edge the component lacks is a size or side variant added in components/ui, not a className here.

{{component}} is sized by the component: text size, weight and leading are not the caller's. Truncation and colour are fine; for a different heading size use a different heading element or a variant in components/ui.
{{component}} is coloured by what it means, not by the caller: variant="success-light" (or another variant) at the default size. A caller may only place it.
